gui.skyabyss.domain.stone_sea.goal: Strike the resonant bones in the order they sounded
gui.skyabyss.domain.rising_tide.goal: Hold all three sluices open at once
gui.skyabyss.domain.thunder_cage.goal: Strike the charged rod to ground the lightning
gui.skyabyss.domain.hearth_core.goal: Crouch beside the ember cores to quench them
message.skyabyss.domain.invulnerable: The heart cannot be hurt during its domain. Solve the puzzle
message.skyabyss.domain.stone_sea.goal: Three bones are ringing on their own. Strike them back in the order they sounded (left or right click)
message.skyabyss.domain.stone_sea.wrong: Wrong note. Listen to the order again
message.skyabyss.domain.rising_tide.goal: Tide sluices stand on the rock islands. Strike them open and keep all three open. An open sluice closes after a while
message.skyabyss.domain.rising_tide.open: A sluice opened (%s / %s). It will not hold for long
message.skyabyss.domain.thunder_cage.goa: The lightning rods charge one at a time. Strike the brightly glowing rod before it fills
message.skyabyss.domain.thunder_cage.spe: The bolt fell and scattered. The rod will charge again
message.skyabyss.domain.thunder_cage.idl: That rod is not charged. Strike the brightly glowing one
message.skyabyss.domain.hearth_core.goal: Three ember cores burn. Crouch beside each to quench it. It warms again if you leave
message.skyabyss.domain.hearth_core.hint: Striking does not cool it. Keep crouching beside it
message.skyabyss.trial_hub.returned: Trial cleared. A tablet in the heartbeat hall lights up
message.skyabyss.trial_hub.sealed: You cleared this trial. It is sealed to you now
gui.skyabyss.trial.title: Trial Board
gui.skyabyss.trial.codex.empty: Trials you have not seen keep their names hidden
gui.skyabyss.trial.weekly_open: Open even if not drawn. Doubles the materials
gui.skyabyss.trial.help: Each cycle draws one trial from Walk, Wit and Fight
message.skyabyss.trial.board_far: The board is too far. Step closer
message.skyabyss.trial.stone_not_yours: This stone belongs to another party's trial
message.skyabyss.trial.first: First time through %s. Added to the codex
message.skyabyss.trial.title: Title earned
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.start: Beams hold still while the bell rings. Cross from beam to beam to the far ledge
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.fell: You slipped. Back to the rest point
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.crossed: You reached the far ledge. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.bell_cooling: The bell is still cooling. %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w02.bell_held: You struck the bell. The beams hold for %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.start: Strike the ribs back in the order shown on the wall. A mistake starts over
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.recall: Press the lectern to see the score again for a moment
message.skyabyss.trial.w06.solved: The score falls silent. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.start: Three of the four handles are alive. Open all three sluices within the grace time and hold. %s weight stones
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.opened: All three sluices are open. The far door opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.flooded: This handle is flooded and does nothing now
message.skyabyss.trial.w07.pulled: A sluice is open. Open the rest within %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.w10.start: Run from cover to cover and bring down the gunners on the rise. Read the cannon telegraph
message.skyabyss.trial.w10.cleared: The gunners are down. The door before the stone opens
trial.skyabyss.cell.W01.desc: Cross the rib valley on crumbling bone footing.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W02.desc: A vertical shaft of beams that hold still to the bell's beat.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W05.desc: Carry light sprouts through dark waterways and light the stands.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W06.desc: Strike the ribs back to the wall's score.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W07.desc: Open three sluices at once with distant handles.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W09.desc: Hold out against waves of sentinels in a sealing hall.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W10.desc: Follow the cover and bring down the gunners on the rise.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T01.desc: Carry a pearl to the altar during the ebb.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T05.desc: Move the water level to climb to the ledge.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T09.desc: Break three nests and fell the Tide Caller.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S01.desc: Climb the bone with updrafts and gliding rings.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S05.desc: Route lightning with wires and levers to the door pillar.
trial.skyabyss.cell.S06.desc: Bend light with feather mirrors onto three receivers.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E01.desc: Scatter ash to make a cooled crust path over lava.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E05.desc: Forge the fire key at the great furnace.
trial.skyabyss.cell.E09.desc: Tend the hearth fire and keep it burning.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W03.desc: Descend a flowing moss slope, using bone islands as footholds.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W04.desc: Ride the blasts up a vertical shaft.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W11.desc: Push the coffin to the altar and guard it from the pack.
trial.skyabyss.cell.W12.desc: Fight on a round floor that falls away wave by wave.
message.skyabyss.trial.w03.start: The moss flows toward the lit wall. Rest on bone islands, read the current, and cross to the next one
message.skyabyss.trial.w03.fell: You fell into the gap. Back to the last island you stood on
message.skyabyss.trial.w03.crossed: You reached the bottom of the slope. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.start: A vent pad flickers white, then blows. Ride the blasts up the ledges to the south exit. The drop into the shaft is gentle
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.plugged: Plug pad pressed. Every blast lasts longer
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.back_down: Back at the bottom. Wait for the next blast
message.skyabyss.trial.w04.reached: You reached the exit ledge. The gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w11.start: The coffin moves while someone stands near it, but not while foes surround it. Split into pushers and guards and bring it to the altar
message.skyabyss.trial.w11.broken: The coffin broke. Back to where the last pack came
message.skyabyss.trial.w11.arrived: The coffin reached the altar. The far gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.w12.start: Beat three waves. The floor falls away after each one. Cracked tiles go first
message.skyabyss.trial.w12.cleared: The arena is yours. The exit bridge appears
message.skyabyss.trial.w12.fell: You fell out of the arena. Back to the foyer
trial.skyabyss.cell.T02.desc: Cross a cove by sandbars at the ebb and floating stones at the flood.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T06.desc: Strike the shells in the order of the mural's colours.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T07.desc: Move the water of two tanks with plugs and match the marks.
trial.skyabyss.cell.T10.desc: Fight on a round island that the rising tide washes away.
message.skyabyss.trial.t02.start: Sandbars at the ebb, floating stones at the flood; the two paths overlap at the turn. Stones sink if you linger. Reach the far shore
message.skyabyss.trial.t02.crossed: You reached the far shore. Ring the stone
message.skyabyss.trial.t02.splash: You fell in. Swim back to a shore or a path
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.start: Strike the seven shells in the order of the mural's colours. Three choruses. A wrong shell clouds the sea
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.rule0: First chorus: the top row, left to right
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.rule1: Second chorus: the bottom row, right to left
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.rule2: Third chorus: top and bottom rows, alternating from the left
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.murk: The sea clouded. This chorus starts over
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.recalled: The mural surfaces for a while
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.recall_coolin: The lectern is still cooling. %s s left
message.skyabyss.trial.t06.solved: The chorus is done. The far gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.start: Move the two seas with the three plugs and match the gold marks at once (A %s / B %s). Hold them. The white plug resets
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.blocked: It will not move further (A %s, B %s)
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.hold: On the marks. Hold for %s s
message.skyabyss.trial.t07.solved: The seas agree. The far gate opens
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.start: Beat three waves. The tide rises each time and washes the island away, sand first, sandstone later
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.cleared: The ring is yours. The exit bridge appears
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.fell: You sank deep. Back to the foyer
message.skyabyss.trial.t10.wet: You are in the water. Get back onto a foothold
